reason: Supplier and PO data is still sensitive even sanitized, and I have no way to know this startup handles it properly. I'd have to get IT and security to sign off, and they will not do that for a free audit from a company I've never heard of, so I don't see it happening inside 30 days.
objection: Who actually sees our data, where it is stored, and what happens to it afterward. A read-only offline process still means sending our supplier terms and job data outside the building, and I've been burned by consultants before.
would_change_my_mind: A written data handling and security summary that my IT lead can review, plus a reference from an Epicor shop of similar size that has already been through the audit.
